svg.title: Wireframe 2: group board states on a phone
svg.desc: Twelve small greyscale states of the LiftOff Comp group board at 375 px width: row menu, editing a weight, refused weight, raised weight that moves later attempts, next lifter changing by itself, refused Enter result, stopped and withdrawn lifters, before the first result, tracked lifter next or finished, two tracked lifters, offline, and group finished.
svg.text: Wireframe 2 · Group board states · phone (375 px)

Each frame is a slice of the board from wireframe 1 (cell states are the same). Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders until the visual tokens. Names and numbers are made up.
A
Row menu
Tap a lifter's name to open the menu under the row.
Track puts the T-minus strip on this lifter.
Stop Snatch cancels the rest of this lift only.
Withdraw cancels everything left. Both are undone with
Restore, so there is no confirm dialog.
B
Editing a weight

g.text: Click away saves · Esc cancels · empty keeps 75

svg.text: Tap a weight: it becomes an empty input.
Click away saves, Esc cancels, an empty value keeps
the old weight.
The hint shows the lowest weight allowed (R10), so the
coach knows the limit before typing.
C
Refused weight

g.text: Weight can not be lower than 73 kg

svg.text: A weight that breaks a rule is not saved. The cell keeps
the old value, gets a red outline and a ! badge (so colour
is not the only cue) and a message with the real limit.
The message stays until the next edit and is read out
by screen readers.
D
Raising moves later attempts up

g.text: Weight can not be higher than 62 kg

svg.text: Attempt 2 raised to 80 moves attempt 3 to 81 (80 + 1).
Moved attempts are estimates again (dashed).
Attempts that already have a result are never moved:
an edit that would break the order with one is refused,
with the limit in the message.
E
The next lifter changes by itself

g.text: ▼ Anna raises her attempt from 73 to 77 kg

svg.text: Anna raises 73 → 77 and is no longer first in the order.
The panel switches to Sara at once, and the flags Anna had
toggled are reset. The table re-sorts at the same time.
Nothing is saved for 'next up': it is always worked
out from the weights (R13).
F
Enter result refused
Enter result sends the shown weight (73 kg) with the flags.
If the weight changed in the meantime, or another coach
already entered the result, the server refuses it.
Nothing is saved, the board refreshes and the coach
checks the flags again.
G
Stopped and withdrawn
Stop Snatch cancels the Snatch only: the Clean & Jerk
attempts stay. Withdraw cancels everything left, in both
lifts. These rows sink to the bottom of their list and
show Restore, which brings the attempts back.
H
Before the first result

g.text: · minutes show after the first lift

svg.text: The group counts as started when the first result is
entered. Until then only lifts are shown, never minutes.
After the first lift the strip becomes
I
Tracked lifter is next, or done

g.text: Tracked lifter has finished the Snatch

svg.text: T–0 is shown as 'You're up next' on a dark strip.
When the Snatch is finished the strip says that the
Clean & Jerk is next. A finished or withdrawn lifter
has no strip.
J
Two tracked lifters + sticky bar
A coach can track two lifters. The first is ME, the
others are shown by name.
Decided: a thin sticky bar under the top bar keeps the
T-minus visible when the list is long and scrolled.
K
Offline

g.text: Results can not be sent while offline

svg.text: No connection: a banner explains it and the board keeps
showing the last data with its time. Refresh and Enter
result are disabled, nothing is queued (offline mode is
a Could, C4).
L
Group finished

g.text: All 7 lifters have no attempts left.

svg.text: When nobody has attempts left the badge says DONE and
the next-lifter panel is replaced by a summary with a
way back. No T-minus strips, all rows are muted.
